rows.column_2: Zirconia with Brown Aluminum Oxide ZA Micro Crystalline Grains MCA Ruby Grains RB Semi friable Aluminum Oxide FS Sol Gel Grain CG 5.3 HSG - GRINDING WHEEL REPLACEMENT AND BALANCING Haas Surface Grinder (HSG) - Grinding Wheel Replacement and Balancing Replacement 1 Remove the grinding wheel from the machine using the provided wheel removal tool. Screw on the removal bolt in the clockwise direction until the grinding wheel is off the taper. �Note : The nut thread is left handed so ensure that the wrench is rotated clockwise. 2 Clean all mating surfaces and place the the wheel balancing base and height gauge on top of a level granite table. Sweep an indicator across the high point of the balancing rail and adjust the bottom 2 knobs untl all 4 corners read withing 0.0001" (0.0025mm). 3 Place the tapered arbor firmly into the grind wheel hub. Place the arbor onto the balancing rails and monitor the rotation of the wheel then let it come to rest. Mark the heavy and light points on the wheel using chalk and add a balance weight to the light side of the wheel. Equally space and place the other 2 balance weight around the wheel hub. Lift and rotate the wheel 90 degrees and rest onto the balancing rails to observe movement. Adjust the location of the weight accordingly until the wheel is able to be placed on all 4 quadrants without movement,

rag_units.text:
Zirconia with Brown Aluminum Oxide
ZA

4
Place wheel hub through rear bore of the grind
wheel then place the hub disk on the opposing
side and tighten the hub nut.

Clean the spindle taper then place the wheel
firmly on it and tighten the wheel nut in the anti-
clockwise direction.

5
Use the handle to manually move the diamond
pen on top of the grind wheel.

Rotate the adjustment knob until the pen
touches the grinding wheel then return the ram
off of the wheel.

Adjust the knob then pull the handle and feed
the diamond per fully accross the grind wheel.
Repeat until the grind wheel is fully dressed.
